# Browser dependency

Leaflet.markercluster **1.5.3**, copied from the repository's existing pinned
Toronto crime map assets. Upstream distribution:
https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/

`markercluster.js`, `markercluster.css` (`MarkerCluster.css`) and
`markercluster-default.css` (`MarkerCluster.Default.css`) are unmodified.
`LICENSE.txt` retains the upstream MIT licence and is also embedded in the HTML.
These committed assets are consumed offline; builds do not fetch dependencies.
